bio: Jermaine Lafrance Johnson Sr. (born July 4, 1985) is an American politician, political advisor and former professional basketball player. A member of the Democratic Party, he is a member for South Carolina House of Representatives, representing the 52nd district. On January 14, 2026, Johnson announced that he would not run for re-election to the South Carolina House of Representatives, opting for a gubernatorial run.
